data.one_liner: Forge2D physics engine support and wrappers for the Flame game engine.
data.what_it_does: Acts as a bridge between the Forge2D (Box2D) physics library and the Flame game engine. It provides wrappers, components, and world management to build physics-based 2D games inside Flutter.
use_when: You are building a 2D game using the Flame engine that requires rigid body physics.
You want to utilize Box2D/Forge2D physics simulations inside your Flame game loop.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine for your project.
Your game does not require complex physics simulations and simple custom movement is enough.
strengths: Seamless integration between Flame and Forge2D.
Handles physics calculations, collision detection, and gravity natively for Flame components.
weaknesses: API changes can be significant when underlying Box2D/Forge2D versions update (such as v3 changes in 0.20.0).
Requires learning both Flame and Forge2D concepts.
data.setup_notes: Add flame_forge2d and flame to your pubspec.yaml file.

alternatives.name: forge2d
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use the Forge2D physics engine directly without the Flame game engine bridge.
